```sql
SELECT 
    p.canal,
    ROUND(AVG(t.ticket), 2) AS ticket_promedio
FROM (
    SELECT 
        pedido_id,
        SUM(cantidad * precio_unitario) AS ticket
    FROM items
    GROUP BY pedido_id
) AS t
JOIN pedidos AS p
    ON p.pedido_id = t.pedido_id
WHERE 
    p.estado = 'entregado'
    AND p.fecha BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-03-31'
GROUP BY p.canal;
```
